name: Cod Curry

source.cookbook: The Complete and Authentic Thai Curry Cookbook 2
source.author: Various

ingredients.item: fresh jalapeno peppers, seeded and diced

method: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the onion, lower the heat, and cook for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until browned.
Add the ginger paste and garlic paste and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the salt, turmeric, cardamom, coriander, cumin, and red curry powder.
Add the diced tomatoes with their juice, lemon juice, cilantro, and jalapeños. Scrape the bottom of the skillet, then cover and simmer gently for about 20 minutes.
Bring the sauce back to a gentle boil, add the cod, then lower the heat and cook for about 12 minutes.
Add the frozen peas and cook for another 2–3 minutes, just until the peas are hot and bright and the cod is cooked through. Serve with jasmine rice.
tips: Serve with jasmine rice. Add the frozen peas in the last 2–3 minutes, just long enough to heat through and stay bright.
